name: 35040 · Calera, AL
findings: ZIP 35040 (Calera) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35040 (Calera) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
